_README: Per-run DECOMPOSITION specs (the generator's third INPUT, Q3 sub-step 3b). Keyed by run_id under 'decomposition'. Each entry carries proposer_pools (dir->modality), verifier_passes (dir->modality), and conditions (the evaluable scored-result specs the extractors lift metrics for). Run-level facts (corpus, scope, gt_reference, study tags) live in the sibling run-facts.json and are NOT duplicated here. Runs absent from this file have not yet been decomposed (run_type stays null). Authored in archetype batches (planning/manifest-3b-conditions-plan.md). gold-standard-v2 migrated verbatim from the inline GS_V2_FACTS constant (Session 94 sidecar refactor).
